objectives.en: Play the bass on the off-beat

text.ru: Бас на шагах 3, 7, 11, 15 даёт «насос»: бочка — пауза — бас.
text.en: The bass on steps 3, 7, 11, 15 gives a pump: kick — gap — bass.

text.ru: [SHIFT] + [RECORD SETTING] — SOUND GENERATOR. [CTRL 1] — Type (Sine…), [CTRL 2] — Freq, [CTRL 3] — Level; [REC] и пэд сохраняют звук.
text.en: [SHIFT] + [RECORD SETTING] — SOUND GENERATOR. [CTRL 1] is Type (Sine…), [CTRL 2] Freq, [CTRL 3] Level; [REC] and a pad save the sound.

text.ru: Удерживая [SUB PAD], выбери бас и нажми пэды шагов 3, 7, 11, 15: пэд = шаг.
text.en: Holding [SUB PAD], pick the bass and press the step pads 3, 7, 11, 15: pad = step.

text.ru: Короткие ноты: RELEASE ([CTRL 3] в огибающей) меньше.
text.en: Short notes: a lower RELEASE ([CTRL 3] in the envelope).

tryIt.ru: Дай басу разный питч ([CTRL 2]) на шагах 3 и 11.
tryIt.en: Give the bass a different pitch ([CTRL 2]) on steps 3 and 11.
